description: Language learning at working depth for professional use; intermediate starting point.

conversation.content: I already speak Spanish fluently and I want to pick up Italian for work — I'm going to be collaborating with a team in Milan. I can read a fair amount of Italian already but speaking is rough. I've got maybe 40 hours over the next couple months and I'd like to be comfortable in meetings.

expected_goal.sub_goal: conversational Italian sufficient for professional meetings, leveraging Spanish base
